reason: Provides a DSH image-attachment bridge that transcribes images through Codex Luna and forwards the resulting text to configurable text-only downstream models.

summaries.zh: 通过 Codex Luna 将 DSH 中的图片附件转写为文字，并交给可配置的纯文本下游模型处理。
summaries.en: Transcribes DSH image attachments with Codex Luna and forwards the resulting text to configurable downstream text models.

capabilities: Reads validated image attachments from the DSH attachment store
Writes temporary image files and deletes them after transcription
Invokes the Codex CLI with the configured Luna model
Persists derived image descriptions in a local cache when enabled
Delegates the resulting text and user request to a configured downstream text model
